cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.5-9B: codegym transfer
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Generalization to unseen environments. Qwen3.5-9B trained on CodeGym: GRPO versus Dyad-GRPO scores on four other environments. Parentheses show percentage-point improvements. Three evaluation seeds, no further adaptation.
